verdict.rationale: Highnote documents API-driven card issuance and management, and a marketing page says each card closes automatically when the workflow ends, which glancingly touches the close step. None of the other named lifecycle operations is evidenced. Missing for 10: activate, pause/unpause (suspend), report lost or stolen, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, an explicit permanent-close API operation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the full card lifecycle is API-driven — activate, pause, unpause, report lost or stolen, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, and permanently close

citations.quote: Create and manage customizable payment cards, including virtual, physical, and tokenized digital cards.
Issue cards per agent, workflow, or vendor via API. Each card closes automatically when the workflow ends.
This guide provides an overview of issuing a financial account and virtual card product using the Highnote API.
